mŏdŭlāmen , ĭnis, n. id.,
I.melody, euphony (post-class.): “(Cicero) in secundā (in Verrem, i. e. Verr. 2, 2, 78, § 191) simili usūs modulamine, manifesto peccatu inquit, non peccato,” Gell. 13, 21 (20), 16: “caeli ac siderum,” Macr. Somn. Scip. 2, 12 ; Sid. Carm. 1, 9.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
